old = '''    def _opt(self, expr, maximize, extra=()):
        """(best value, model) of expr over base+extra, or (None, None)."""
        opt = self.opt
        opt.push()
        if extra:
            opt.add(*extra)
        handle = opt.maximize(expr) if maximize else opt.minimize(expr)
        res = opt.check()
        if res == z3.sat:
            model = opt.model()
            value = model.eval(expr, model_completion=True).as_long()
        else:
            model = None
            value = None
        opt.pop()
        if res == z3.unknown:
            raise RuntimeError('z3 returned unknown')
        return value, model
'''
new = '''    def _value(self, model, expr):
        return model.eval(expr, model_completion=True).as_long()

    def opt_min(self, expr, low, cur):
        """Minimum of expr over F.

        ``low`` is a valid (possibly unattained) lower bound and ``cur`` an
        attained value, so the answer lies in [low, cur].
        """
        if cur <= low:
            return cur
        model = self._model([expr <= low])
        if model is not None:
            return low
        best = cur
        lo = low + 1
        while lo < best:
            mid = (lo + best) // 2
            model = self._model([expr <= mid])
            if model is not None:
                value = self._value(model, expr)
                if value < best:
                    best = value
            else:
                lo = mid + 1
        return best

    def opt_max(self, expr, high, cur):
        """Maximum of expr over F, with the answer in [cur, high]."""
        if cur >= high:
            return cur
        model = self._model([expr >= high])
        if model is not None:
            return high
        best = cur
        hi = high - 1
        while hi > best:
            mid = (best + hi + 1) // 2
            model = self._model([expr >= mid])
            if model is not None:
                value = self._value(model, expr)
                if value > best:
                    best = value
            else:
                hi = mid - 1
        return best
'''
